provenance: Original STAT 709 drawings from canonical examples; synthetic samples are explicitly labeled. No external artwork copied.

figures.name: partition
figures.title: Information from coin tosses
figures.alt: The same four outcomes HH, HT, TH, TT form two blocks after the first toss and four singleton blocks after both tosses. More information gives a finer partition.

figures.name: continuity
figures.title: Continuity from below
figures.alt: Nested disks of radii 1 minus 2 to the minus n fill the open unit disk. Their areas increase to pi. The finite sketch illustrates an infinite sequence.

figures.name: product
figures.title: Rectangles approximate a disk
figures.alt: Dyadic squares lying inside the open unit disk give increasingly fine inner approximations. Rectangles generate the product Borel sigma-algebra, which also contains nonrectangular sets.

figures.name: maps
figures.title: Observations and transformations
figures.alt: Solid arrows map outcomes forward through X and h. Dashed arrows pull an event C back through h and then X; the pulled-back event lives in the original sample space.
